notes.title: Update for All Seekers ✨
notes.notes:
Friends, we're thrilled to present this major update! We've put our heart into every detail to make your favorite hidden object game even cozier and more engaging.

What's new:

New languages added

Fresh achievements for keen explorers

Smoother gameplay with bug fixes

Hidden improvements to discover

🔍 Immerse yourself in this charming world of mysterious farms, sweet bakeries and ancient castles. Every found item brings joy!

Thank you for your support. Update now and enjoy!
